patch_sets.name: Fix export endpoint chain (P0)
patch_sets.strategy: Add ApiClient.getBlob() method that uses res.blob() instead of res.json(). Route tickets.exportData(), projects.exportData(), and audit.exportData() to use getBlob(). Verify frontend export buttons trigger the correct method.

patch_sets.name: Auth page UX polish
patch_sets.strategy: Add metadata exports to all 5 auth pages. Create loading.tsx in (public) route group with spinner matching marketing design.

patch_sets.name: Server action standardization
patch_sets.strategy: Wrap all 7 server action bodies in try/catch returning { ok, error }. Remove bare throw statements. Update client components to check result.ok instead of try/catch.

patch_sets.name: Ticket comments SDK type fix
patch_sets.strategy: Change listComments() return type from PaginatedResult<TicketComment> to TicketComment[] to match API response. Verify callers in frontend components.

patch_sets.name: Dead schema cleanup
patch_sets.strategy: Create migration to DROP 9 unused tables. Verify worker doesn't SQL-reference webhook_dead_letters before dropping. Add migration: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.appointments, public.chat_messages, public.chat_threads, public.comments, public.contracts, public.contract_signers, public.document_permissions, public.onboarding_submissions, public.project_members;

patch_sets.name: Missing indexes
patch_sets.strategy: Create migration adding 3 indexes: idx_notifications_org (organization_id, created_at DESC), idx_billing_customers_org (organization_id), idx_document_shares_org (organization_id).

patch_sets.name: Minor schema + SDK cleanup
patch_sets.strategy: 1) Split SDK tests into per-module files. 2) Move infra/terraform/aws/ to archive/. 3) Add ON DELETE SET NULL to memberships.role_id FK. 4) Verify multer field name matches FormData.append('file') in upload().

unresolved.impact: All 3 export features (tickets, projects, audit) broken end-to-end
unresolved.fix: Add getBlob() method using res.blob(). Route exportData() through getBlob().

unresolved.impact: Login, signup, forgot-password, password-reset, pending show 'Untitled' in browser tab
unresolved.fix: Add export const metadata = { title: '...' } to each page

unresolved.impact: Marketing pages have no loading state during data fetches

unresolved.issue: 7 of 12 server actions throw errors instead of returning { ok, error }
unresolved.impact: Inconsistent error handling DX — callers must handle both patterns
unresolved.fix: Wrap all server action bodies in try/catch returning { ok, error }

unresolved.issue: listComments() typed as PaginatedResult<TicketComment> but API returns TicketComment[]
unresolved.impact: Runtime crash when frontend accesses .data on plain array

unresolved.issue: 10 DB tables with zero API/SDK/frontend usage — full-stack dead code
unresolved.impact: Schema bloat, migration noise, cognitive load

unresolved.impact: Admin queries by org scan notifications table
unresolved.fix: CREATE INDEX idx_notifications_org ON public.notifications(organization_id, created_at DESC)

unresolved.fix: Split into per-module test files (tickets.test.ts, documents.test.ts, etc.)
